translations.text: The word concerning Nineveh: the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
God is jealous, and the Lord takes vengeance with wrath. The Lord will take vengeance on his enemies, and he will take away his enemies.
The Lord is long-suffering, and his power is great, and the Lord will by no means clear the guilty. His way is in destruction and in earthquake, and the cloud is the dust of his feet.
He rebukes the sea and dries it up, and he has laid waste all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel have dwindled, and the flowers of Lebanon have withered away.
The mountains quaked because of him, and the hills were shaken, and the whole earth was seized with fear before his face, and all who live on it.
Who will stand before the face of his wrath? Or who will withstand the fury of his anger? His anger melts the mountains, and the rocks were shattered by him.
The Lord is kind to those who wait patiently for him in the time of distress, and he knows those who fear him.
And with the flood of his advance he will make an end, also of those who had risen up, and darkness will pursue his enemies.
What do you plot against the Lord? He will make an end, and he will not take vengeance twice over in affliction.
For it will be laid waste down to its foundation, and it will be devoured like a tangled bramble, and like a reed-bed full of dryness.
From which came out a plan against the Lord, devising evil, hostile to him.
Thus says the Lord, who rules over many waters: "And so they will be cut off, and the report of you will be heard no more.
And now I will break his rod from off you, and I will burst your bonds."

And the Lord will give command concerning you: none of your name shall be sown any more. From the house of your God I will destroy the idols and the molten images; I will make your grave, for it comes swiftly.
Behold, on the mountains are the feet of one who brings good news and who proclaims peace! Keep your feasts, O Judah; pay your vows, for they will never again pass through you to wear you down.
It is accomplished; it is finished.
One who breathes in your face has come up to rescue you from affliction. Watch the road, strengthen your loins, be very strong in might.
For the Lord has turned away the insolence of Jacob, as the insolence of Israel, for plunderers have utterly shaken them out and have ruined their possessions.
The weapons of his might are from men, mighty men who mock with fire; the reins [?] of their chariots on the day of his preparation; and the horsemen will be thrown into confusion
on the road, and the chariots will crash together and will be entangled in the streets. Their appearance is like torches of fire and like lightning flashing to and fro.
They remembered their great men, and they flee by day, and they grow weak as they go, and they hurry toward the wall, and their defenses [?] are prepared.
The gates of the cities were opened, and the palaces fell.
And her substance was laid bare, and she was going up; and her maidservants were being led away like doves, moaning in their hearts.
And Nineveh's waters are like a pool of water, and they were fleeing and did not stand, and there was no one who looked back.
They were plundering silver and gold, and there was no end to her adornment; she is weighed down beyond all their precious vessels.
Shaking out and shaking up, and casting out, and trembling of heart, and loosening of knees, and pains in all loins, and the faces of all of them like something scorched before a pot.
Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the pasture that belonged to the cubs? Where the lion went to enter, there was the lion's cub, and there was no one to frighten them.
The lion seized plenty for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his den with prey, and his dwelling with plunder.

Behold, I am against you, says the Lord Almighty, and I will burn up your multitude in smoke, and the sword will devour your lions, and I will destroy your prey from the earth, and your deeds will no longer be heard.
O bloody city, wholly lying, full of falsehood! The hand shall not touch the prey.
The sound of scourgings, and the sound of the rumbling of chariot wheels, and the galloping of horses, and the rattling of chariots,

and the mounting of horsemen, and the flashing of the sword, and the lightning of weapons, and of the multitude of the wounded, and of the mass of the fallen; and there is no number to her wounds, and they shall grow weak in their bodies through the multitude of fornication.
A harlot, fair and charming, leader of sorcerers, who [sells?] nations through her fornication, and tribes through her sorceries.
Behold, I am against you, says the Lord God Almighty, and I will uncover your hinder parts before your face, and show the nations your shame, and the kings your disgrace.
And I will bring abomination upon you according to your impurities, and I will make you [a spectacle?].
And it shall be that everyone who sees you will go down from you and say: "Wretched Nineveh! Who will sigh for her? Where shall I seek comfort for her?"
Let the portion of sand be counted, you who dwell by the rivers; water is around her, whose beginning is the sea, and water is her wall.
Ethiopia and Egypt are her strength, and there is no end to her flight, and the Libyans were her helpers.
Yet she went into exile as a captive, and their infants were dashed down at the head of all her ways, and they will cast lots over all her nobles, and all their great men will be bound in fetters.
And you will be drunk and disregarded, and you will seek for yourself a place to stand against the enemies.
All your strongholds have fig trees with watchmen; if they are shaken, they will fall into the mouth of the eater.
Behold, your people within you are like women; the gates of your land will be opened wide to your enemies, and fire will devour your bars.
Draw water around yourself; seize all your strongholds; go into the clay and be trampled together with the chaff; hold fast beyond the brick.
There fire will devour you, the sword will destroy you, and it will devour you like a locust, and you will be weighed down like a fly.
Multiply your merchandise like the stars of heaven. The fly sprang out and flew away.
Your [?] went out like locusts, like the locust that climbs onto a fence on a day of frost. The sun rose and they flew away, and its place was not known. Woe to them!
For your shepherds have slumbered; the king of Assyria has put your mighty men to sleep; your people have set out toward the mountains, and there is no one to receive you.
And there is no healing for your bruise; your wound has swollen. All who hear the report of you will clap their hands over you because of this, for upon whom has your wickedness not come continually?
